# updawg_hosts (Data Source)

The organization's hosts, filtered, by hostname. For putting existing hosts into an `updawg_group` by hand, or anything else that should follow the fleet as it is. Needs the token scope `read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every web host that needs a reboot.
data "updawg_hosts" "web_reboots" {
  labels          = { tier = "web" }
  reboot_required = ["yes"]
}

# Hand-pick them into a group.
resource "updawg_group" "reboot_tonight" {
  name  = "reboot tonight"
  hosts = data.updawg_hosts.web_reboots.ids
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `distros` (Set of String) Only hosts running one of these distributions, such as `ubuntu` or `rocky`.
- `labels` (Map of String) Only hosts carrying **all** of these labels with these values.
- `org` (String) The organization's slug. Defaults to the provider's `org`.
- `reboot_required` (Set of String) Only hosts whose reboot state is one of `yes`, `no` or `unknown`.
- `statuses` (Set of String) Only hosts in one of these states, such as `active` or `stale`.

### Read-Only

- `hosts` (Attributes List) The matching hosts, in hostname order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hosts))
- `ids` (List of String) The matching hosts' `hst_…` ids, in hostname order.

<a id="nestedatt--hosts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `hosts`

Read-Only:

- `agent_version` (String) The agent it runs, once it has said.
- `arch` (String) The architecture.
- `display_name` (String) The name given in the portal, if any.
- `distro` (String) The distribution.
- `distro_version` (String) Its version.
- `hostname` (String) As the host reports it.
- `id` (String) `hst_…`.
- `labels` (Map of String) Its labels.
- `reboot_required` (Boolean) Whether it needs a reboot; null when it cannot tell.
- `status` (String) The host's state.
